title: Indlela Yokuguqula Iividiyo Zemidiya Yoluntu Zibe yi-MP3
description: Guqula iividiyo ze-TikTok, Instagram, Facebook ne-X zibe yi-MP3 ngaphandle kwe-app. Ncamathisela ilinki kwi-I Need Save, ukhethe i-MP3 ye-192 kbps.
photoCaption: I-MP3 ilungele ukudlalwa kuso nasiphi na isixhobo.
photo2Caption: Khetha i-MP3 ukuba ufuna ilizwi kuphela.
body:
Ngamanye amaxesha into oyifunayo kwividiyo asingomfanekiso, kodwa lilizwi layo. Isenokuba yingoma emnandi engasemva, isiqwenga se-podcast, okanye intshumayelo ofuna ukuyimamela xa uqhuba. Endaweni yokugcina ividiyo yonke ethatha indawo yokugcina, ungaguqula iividiyo zemidiya yoluntu zibe yi-MP3 ngqo kwi-browser nge-I Need Save. Ngaphandle kwe-app eyongezelelweyo, ngaphandle kokungena, kwaye simahla.

Kutheni Ugcina Njengesandi?

Kukho izizathu ezimbalwa ezenza ifomathi yesandi idla ngokuba lula:

  • Iifayile ezincinci. Iifayile zesandi zilula kakhulu kuneevidiyo, ngoko indawo yokugcina yefowuni yakho ihlala ixesha elide.
  • Zidlala naphi na. I-MP3 iyaziwa phantse zizo zonke izidlali zomculo, kwifowuni nakwikhompyutha.
  • Kumnandi ukumamela. Ungamamela ngelixa wenza enye into ngaphandle kokujonga isikrini.

Ngawaphi Amaqonga Onokuthatha Isandi Sawo?

I-I Need Save isebenza nokuthunyelweyo okuvulelekileyo okuvela kumaqonga amaninzi, kuquka i-TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), Pinterest, Snapchat Spotlight, Tumblr, LinkedIn, Bluesky, iiklip ze-Twitch, SoundCloud, Dailymotion, Imgur, 9GAG, ne-Streamable. Kwi-Instagram, khumbula ukuba eli qonga ngamanye amaxesha livimba izicelo okanye lifune ukungena.

Njengesaziso, i-YouTube, Reddit, ne-Vimeo okwangoku azixhaswa kuba loo maqonga avimba iseva.

Indlela Yokuguqula Ividiyo Ibe yi-MP3 Inyathelo Ngenyathelo

Indlela iyafana kuwo onke amaqonga axhaswayo:

  1. Vula i-app yemidiya yoluntu uze ukhangele ividiyo ofuna ukugcina isandi sayo.
  2. Cofa iqhosha elithi Yabelana (Share), uze ukhethe Kopa ilinki (Copy link).
  3. Vula i-browser uze undwendwele i-ineedsave.com.
  4. Ncamathisela ilinki kwibhokisi ekhoyo, okanye ucofe iqhosha elithi Ncamathisela.
  5. Cofa Khuphela uze ulinde de kuvele uluhlu lokhetho.
  6. Kwicandelo elithi Isandi, khetha i-MP3 ye-192 kbps okanye isandi somgangatho wokuqala.
  7. Linda kancinci. Ukuba iqhosha libonisa Iyalungiselela…, ifayile iyasetyenzwa kwaye ukukhuphela kuya kuqala ngokuzenzekelayo xa ilungile.

Kugqityiwe! Ifayile yesandi ngoku igcinwe kwisixhobo sakho.

Isandi Sokuqala okanye i-MP3 ye-192 kbps: Yeyiphi Ofanele Uyikhethe?

Kwicandelo elithi Isandi kudla ngokubakho iintlobo ezimbini zokhetho. Ngalunye lunezinto zalo ezilungileyo.

Isandi somgangatho wokuqala

Esi sisandi njengoko sinikwe liqonga, ngaphandle kokuguqulwa kwakhona. Khetha olu khetho ukuba ufuna umgangatho welizwi uhlale unjengokuba unjalo ekuqaleni.

I-MP3 ye-192 kbps

Olu khetho sisiphumo sokuguqula ividiyo ibe yifomathi ye-MP3 ene-bitrate ye-192 kbps. Inzuzo yayo kukusebenza kuyo yonke indawo: i-MP3 idlala phantse kuzo zonke izixhobo nee-app zomculo, kuquka izidlali ezindala ezimotweni okanye izithethi.

Icebiso: Ukuba uyathandabuza, khetha i-MP3 ye-192 kbps. Umgangatho wayo umnandi ukumamelwa kumculo nakwiincoko, kwaye yifomathi elula kakhulu ukudlalwa naphi na.

Iingcamango Zokusebenzisa Iifayile ze-MP3

Xa sele unefayile yesandi, kukho iindlela ezininzi zokuyonwabela:

  • Mamela ngaphandle kwe-intanethi. Yidlale xa uhamba okanye kwindawo enesignali ebuthathaka ngaphandle kokuchitha idatha.
  • Funda ngelixa wenza ezinye izinto. Gcina iziqwenga zezifundo, udliwano-ndlebe, okanye iingcebiso ozifumene kwimidiya yoluntu, uze uzimamele ngelixa upheka okanye usenza umthambo.
  • Ugcino lwakho. Gcina amazwi akhumbulekayo, umzekelo imiyalezo yosapho ekwabelwene ngayo kwi-akhawunti evulelekileyo.

Ngenxa yokuba iifayile zincinci, ungagcina iifayile zesandi ezininzi ngaphandle kokuxhalaba ukuba indawo yokugcina iza kugcwala ngokukhawuleza.

Iifayile ze-MP3 Zigcinwa Phi?

  • I-Android nekhompyutha: ifayile ingena kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo). Ungayivula nge-app yokulawula iifayile okanye isidlali somculo.
  • I-iPhone/iPad (Safari): ifayile ingena kwi-app ethi Files, kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo). Ukusuka apho ungayidlala ngqo.

Ufuna isikhokelo esineenkcukacha ngakumbi malunga nendawo yeefayile? Funda inqaku elithi iifayile ezikhutshelweyo zigcinwa phi.

Iifayile zidluliselwa ngqo zisuka kwiqonga lokuqala ziye kwisixhobo sakho kwaye azigcinwa kwiseva ye-I Need Save.

Ukuba Ukhetho Lwesandi Aluveli okanye Aluphumeleli

Ezinye iimeko zenza isandi singakwazi ukuthathwa:

  • Ividiyo ivela kwi-akhawunti yabucala.
  • Umxholo ubonakala kuphela emva kokungena.
  • Umxholo uthintelwe kwimimandla ethile.
  • Ilinki ivela kwiqonga elingekaxhaswa.

Zama ukukopa kwakhona ilinki ngqo kwiqhosha elithi Yabelana, uze uphinde inkqubo.

Hlonipha Ilungelo Lokushicilela Lomculo

Iingoma neerekhodi zamazwi zikhuselwe lilungelo lokushicilela. Sebenzisa iifayile zesandi ozikhuphelileyo kuphela ukuze uzimamele wena. Ukuba ufuna ukuzisebenzisa kwakhona kwomnye umxholo, cela imvume kumnini uze ukhankanye igama lakhe ngokucacileyo.

Imibuzo Ebuzwa Rhoqo

Ngaba ndidinga i-app yokuguqula?

Hayi. Ukuguqulela kwi-MP3 kwenziwa ngqo nge-I Need Save, ngoko udinga i-browser kuphela.

Ndingathatha isandi kwividiyo ye-TikTok?

Ewe. Amanyathelo ayafana, khetha nje ukhetho oluthi Isandi emva kokucofa Khuphela. Ukuba ufuna nokugcina ividiyo, jonga indlela yokukhuphela iividiyo ze-TikTok ngaphandle kwe-watermark.

I-MP3 eveliswayo inomgangatho onjani?

Iifayile ze-MP3 ziguqulwa nge-bitrate ye-192 kbps. Ukuba ufuna isandi esingaguqulwanga, khetha isandi somgangatho wokuqala.
